sources.title: P.B.Richter1909 Beitrage zur Flora der unteren Kreide Quedlinburgs II Nathorstiana
sources.notes: Personally read printedp4 actual PDF8 pixels (local filename-p2 is inaccurate page label) and PlateX actual PDF21 photographs/casts. Short unbranched axis, narrow leaves with expanded bases, meridional basal depressions, root scars and roots. Historical reproductive interpretation speculative, not adopted. Public-domain1909 edition per BHL, nevertheless consult-only and not redistributed.
